title: Wild Flowers Floral Border Clipart Set
author: Patishop Art
description:
Capture the essence of a serene meadow in full bloom with our wild flowers floral clipart collection. These soft watercolor florals are a delicate portrayal of the vibrant meadow flowers that grace the summer landscape. Each element is meticulously crafted, offering you a versatile selection of premade borders and premade wedding clipart in png format. Elevate your projects with the timeless beauty of these hand-painted watercolor illustrations, perfect for adding a touch of nature’s elegance to invitations, stationery, or any creative endeavor. Explore the essence of summer in every petal and leaf with our exquisite floral clipart.
♡What is included:
10 premade borders, size approx.: 4031 x 1703 px | 13″x5.7″, and smaller
All files are high resolution (300dpi) and have a transparent background (.png)
~ for the best results please use white or light color background
